title: Sara Duterte declared businesses but not value of stocks | The wRap
summary: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world: The prosecution in Vice President

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Sara Duterte trial: She declared businesses over the years, but not value of stocks

blocks.text: The prosecution in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial seeks to establish… she did not declare the value of her new business stocks despite being listed in her Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth or SALN through the years.

items: Mastura: 3 biggest BARMM parties should form coalition

blocks.text: Bangsamoro Member of Parliament-elect Ishak Mastura says the three biggest parties in the region should form a coalition government.

items: Court denies Sara Duterte’s request to inhibit judge from grave threats case

blocks.text: A Quezon City court denies Vice President Sara Duterte’s motion to inhibit the presiding judge in her grave threats case, citing lack of merit.

items: DOJ subpoenas Robin Padilla over Bato dela Rosa escape

blocks.text: The Justice Department issues a subpoena for Senator Robin Padilla over the obstruction of justice complaints filed against him. This, for his alleged role in the escape of Senator Bato Dela Rosa.

items: US judge blocks Trump limits on how long foreign students, journalists can stay

blocks.text: A federal judge blocks U.S. President Donald Trump‘s administration from implementing a new rule that would limit how long foreign students and journalists can remain in the US without applying for extensions. – Rappler.com
